chunks: Sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs.
Allah, the Exalted, said: 'He who disbelieves in Taghut and believes in Allah has certainly grasped the most firm handhold, which will not break.' And Allah knows where the pious are.
Allah, the Exalted, said: 'And Allah guides whom He wills to a straight path.'

key_terms.الطَّاغُوت: Taghut (any entity worshipped besides Allah or tyrannical rulers)
key_terms.الْعُرْوَةُ الْوُثْقَى: The firmest handhold (referring to Islam or the Prophet's family)

ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of the 'firm handhold' in the Quran?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq utilizes these verses to establish the theological foundation of *Al-Urwa Al-Wuthqa* (the Firm Handhold), interpreting it not merely as individual faith but as the collective adherence to the Ahl al-Bayt and the Imams who serve as the tangible manifestation of divine guidance. This narrative underscores the Shia doctrine that true guidance is contingent upon recognizing the divinely appointed authority, linking the rejection of *Taghut* (arbitrary power/ego) with the acceptance of the Imamate as the path to salvation.
